design_philosophy: Calm, professional, and trustworthy clinical interface. Focuses on data density without feeling cluttered. Uses matte surfaces, warm off-white backgrounds, and deep forest greens to reduce eye strain over long shifts.

card.base: bg-white border border-[#E3DFD5] rounded-lg shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(24,35,30,0.04)] overflow-hidden

button.primary: bg-[#274f38] text-white hover:bg-[#1E3D2B] rounded-md font-medium px-5 py-2.5 transition-colors
button.secondary: bg-[#E5EBE8] text-[#274f38] hover:bg-[#DCE3E0] rounded-md font-medium px-5 py-2.5 transition-colors
button.outline: border border-[#E3DFD5] text-[#18231E] hover:border-[#274F38] hover:text-[#274F38] rounded-md font-medium px-5 py-2.5 transition-all

input.base: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#E3DFD5] rounded-md text-[#18231E] placeholder-[#A1ACA6] focus:border-[#274F38] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#274F38] transition-all

badge.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-[#F0EFEA] text-[#586960]

layout_strategies.admin_dashboard: Control Room Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap (gap-6). Use full height widgets.
layout_strategies.schedule_builder: Grid-based timeline view. Horizontal scrolling for days, vertical for time. Use JetBrains Mono for times. Highlight breaks in muted terracotta (#FDF4E7).
layout_strategies.matching_engine: List view with progressive disclosure. Proximity score visualised as a mini health-bar next to skill alignment.
layout_strategies.client_intake: Centered narrow container (max-w-2xl). Multi-step form with sticky bottom action bar. Generous vertical spacing between form groups.

images.description: Clean and organized medical office desk, perfect for healthcare settings.
Abstract patterned texture with organic shapes.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Prefer clean, unbroken lines (stroke-width: 1.5). For complex dashboard actions, use subtle dual-tone if supported.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. DO NOT USE ANY BLUE, PURPLE, OR TEAL (#1B93A4) for components. Use the Deep Forest green (#274F38) as the primary brand color.
Ensure all interactive elements and major data points include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='schedule-block-3pm').
Use Shadcn components for forms, tabs, and modals, but customize them to match the muted earthy tone (remove sharp black borders, use #E3DFD5 instead).

For the Map View, use a simple grid layout or a mock container with an SVG icon if a map library isn't available. Avoid complex Google Maps if not necessary; a static UI with coordinates is fine for MVP.
Implement the Block Schedule Builder using CSS Grid, ensuring accurate sizing for 30-min increments. Add a red/terracotta visual block for 'Rest Break Required' when a shift exceeds 3.5 hours.
Use JetBrains Mono or monospace styling for any time inputs, duration bars, or schedule grids to ensure clear readability.
Avoid Inter for headings. Use Outfit or Manrope.
